description: Complete N=5 flat-top hexagonal L0 P3DM terrain corpus for the reusable regional terrain manager.

world_manifest.contract: WORLD binds every dense cell ID to its axial identity, relative path, length, SHA-256, geometry counts, elevation bounds, materials, and padding witnesses.

hex_profile.topology: flat-top hexagonal cells on one exact triangular lattice
hex_profile.boundary_contract: Six straight sides; each side has six collinear samples and five consecutive perimeter edges; all neighbor seam keys are exact.
hex_profile.cell_id_equation: floor(q/2)*469 + (235 if q odd else 0) + r + floor(q/2)

normalization.pingo_y: NAVD88 elevation with a 608 m object-origin translation

blender_review.preview_lod: one centre and six triangles per cell across all 50,183 cells

validation.builder_round_trip_policy: Every emitted P3DM component is parsed and compared with its in-memory source before publication.
validation.boundary_regression: All six sides are collinear subdivisions rather than sawtooth approximations.
